page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top left, page number at top right. One column of running text, with two marginal notes in the right margin at the top. Question headings are set centred, apart from the text. Signature and catchword at the foot: signature at the centre left, catchword at the right.

main_text.p: Sunt adhuc duæ. Alius namque est motus unus,Lib.5. alius est motus contrarius. Cæterum priusquam decap.3. his plenius differamus, necesse est quasdam definitiones explicari: veluti, quid sit esse simul, vel esse separatim, quid sit contingere vel contiguum esse, quid sit medium seu intermedians, quid sit continuo movens, quid sit ex ordine se habens, quid iunctum vel insequens ex ordine, quid continuum. Quas definitiones nisi quis tenuerit, disputationes sequentes non plane assequentur.
main_text.head: Quæ dicuntur simul esse?
main_text.p: Simul sunt secundum locum, quæ videlicet con-tinentur eodem loco primo. Est autem locus pri-mus, uniuscuiusque rei locus proprius, quem res ipsa per naturam maxime appetit. Locus imus vel infe-rior, est locus primus corporis gravis; supremus vero locus, est locus primus corporis levis. Opponi-tur locus primus loco communi.
main_text.head: Quæ dicuntur esse sepa-ratim?
main_text.p: Quæ in diuersis distinctisque locis sunt.
main_text.head: Quæ dicuntur contingere vel contigua esse?
main_text.p: Quorum extrema simul sunt, adeoque secum mu-tuò conveniunt.

page.notes: Printed text is clear throughout. Doubtful: the first marginal note reads "Lib.5." with the numeral uncertain (possibly "Lib.7."); the second note reads "cap.3." with the numeral uncertain. The signature "b 4" is partly worn. The catchword "Quid" is clear. Printing errors left as printed: "ueró" written as "verò", and the spacing in "grauis;supremus" in the original rendered as "gravis; supremus".
